name: cartana
description: Cartana streamlines Cartesi Rollup development by integrating essential tools directly into Visual Studio Code.

viewsWelcome.title: Cartana Sidebar
viewsWelcome.contents:
Cartana is designed to streamline the development of Cartesi Rollup applications. 

 Cartana simplifies the process of creating, building, running, and deploying Cartesi applications. 

 Get started with the following options: 

[ 📝 Create a New Project](command:cartana.createNewProject "Create Project") 

[ 📂 Open an Existing Project](command:cartana.openExistingProject "Open Project") 

 Or 

[ 📂 Use Project Template](command:cartana.openTemplatesMenu "Use Template") 

For more information about Cartana, check out [Documentation 📚](https://github.com/Cartana-Studio/Cartana-vs-code)

For additional inquiries, please [Contact Us 📧](https://mailto:support@cartana.io)
